cards.teaserMissing: Pick a news item or article to show in this card.

figures.noValue: This figure has no value in this language: it is not shown.

accordion.noTitle: This entry has no heading in this language: it is not shown.

tabs.noTitle: This tab has no label in this language: it is not shown, nor what it holds.
